worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14109012/assets/118759b163a4410f66d5855d7b7b1fd9c2ee4be585e778a759997036bd95f765.png)

The chain rule for a multivariable function $f(x,y)$ with two independent variables $s$ and $t,$ where $x=x(s,t)$ and $y=y(s,t),$ can be expressed as follows:

$$
\frac{∂f}{∂t}=\frac{∂f}{∂x}\cdot \frac{∂x}{∂t}+\frac{∂f}{∂y}\cdot \frac{∂y}{∂t}
$$

First, we find the partial derivatives of $f$ with respect to $x$ and $y:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x}=2xy,\,\frac{∂f}{∂y}={x}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Writing the above results in terms of $s$ and $t,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} & =2(ts)(s-t)=2t{s}^{2}-2s{t}^{2}, \\ \frac{∂f}{∂y} & =(ts)^{2}={t}^{2}{s}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we take the derivatives of $x$ and $y$ with respect to $t,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂x}{∂t} & =s, \\ \frac{∂y}{∂t} & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting all of our derivatives into the multivariable chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂t} & =\frac{∂f}{∂x}\cdot \frac{∂x}{∂t}+\frac{∂f}{∂y}\cdot \frac{∂y}{∂t} \\  & =(2t{s}^{2}-2s{t}^{2})(s)+({t}^{2}{s}^{2})(-1) \\  & =2t{s}^{3}-2{s}^{2}{t}^{2}-{t}^{2}{s}^{2} \\  & =2t{s}^{3}-3{t}^{2}{s}^{2} \\  & =t{s}^{2}(2s-3t).\end{aligned}
$$

Question 14
?

Let f(x,y)=yx2, where x=ts and y=s−t. Calculate ∂f∂t.

a
ts(t2−3ts+2s2)
b
ts(1+ts)(1−st)
c
ts2(2s−3t)
d
st2(s−2t)
e
t(s2+s+1)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The chain rule for a multivariable function f(x,y) with two independent variables s and t, where x=x(s,t) and y=y(s,t), can be expressed as follows: ∂f∂t=∂f∂x⋅∂x∂t+∂f∂y⋅∂y∂t

First, we find the partial derivatives of f with respect to x and y: ∂f∂x=2xy,∂f∂y=x2

Writing the above results in terms of s and t, we get ∂f∂x=2(ts)(s−t)=2ts2−2st2,∂f∂y=(ts)2=t2s2.

Next, we take the derivatives of x and y with respect to t, and we get ∂x∂t=s,∂y∂t=−1.

Finally, substituting all of our derivatives into the multivariable chain rule, we get ∂f∂t=∂f∂x⋅∂x∂t+∂f∂y⋅∂y∂t=(2ts2−2st2)(s)+(t2s2)(−1)=2ts3−2s2t2−t2s2=2ts3−3t2s2=ts2(2s−3t).
